answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to stake a small deposit on a public ledge of verifiable work before it can trade: one cheap identity buys nothing, while many fake identities each pay the stake, so creating an army of sock puppets spirals in cost. Trusted peers then link attestations into a trellis of mutual checks, so a lone fake cannot vouch for itself and the network detects clusters that only endorse each other.
